correctness.rationale: Trim accepting runs have exactly three disjoint depth layers since different accepting-prefix lengths would generate wrongly sized accepted words. For each letter a_i an accepting path passes through a private distinct depth-one p_i; sharing would accept a_i a_j. In a cactus a final state cannot be adjacent to three distinct selected p_i because K2,3 yields two simple cycles sharing an edge; hence >=ceil(n/2) final states. Tree case forbids any pair sharing final, so >=n finals; planar K2,n and matching-cactus/tree constructions attain all lower bounds. At odd n an extra middle-to-final edge in any equality case makes two four-cycles share the edge from s to that middle vertex, forcing unique singleton and perfect pair matching. Independent NetworkX block-cycle enumeration for n=1..4 checked normalized NFA minima and exact numbers of labeled optimal end-state assignments (1,1,6,6).
